prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a hunched old wizard in a long black robe patterned with small silver stars, a wide-brimmed tall pointed black hat, a long grey beard, a hooked nose and two bright glowing yellow eyes clearly visible under the brim, clearly visible silver stars on the robe, holding one gnarled wooden staff in the hand on the right side of the image in every cell; centred in its own cell with empty space on both sides, the hat tip well below the top of the grey box. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: his bearded face with glowing yellow eyes under the hat brim is readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, leaning his body far forward toward the heroes and raising the staff upright in front of his chest with both hands, the staff vertical (not pointed forward), its top level with the hat brim and glowing faintly, the whole staff well inside the middle cell, the glowing yellow eyes wide under the brim, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, the hat tipped askew, the free hand thrown up, the staff upright in the same hand, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a clear diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight onto one leg, lean the torso toward the heroes and thrust the staff and free hand with the elbows bent, so every reaching part stays well inside its own cell. Draw only the parts and clothing named in the description, the same in every cell: no cape, cloak or extra cloth, and no spell effects, smear or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a sword, armour, a crown, an orb, spell effects, a cape, a second staff.
